source.sourceReaderTitleSpanish: Olor a gas en la zanja
source.sourceLessonTitleEnglish: Stop-Work Radio Call: Gas Smell at the Trench
source.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Stop work by radio, give short clear orders to clear the area and call emergency services and the gas utility.

openDomainReview.question: Preserve the Jefferson Street widening job near a school, Raúl's report that the bucket hit something, strong gas smell and hiss, Javier's stop-work order, and the conditional machine shutoff. Review Japanese gas, trench and ignition terminology with qualified construction and utility specialists; do not turn the scene into universal emergency procedure.

Preserve the north-corner assembly point as a wind-dependent scene detail, its conditional relocation, the source's US 911 call and reported firefighters. Review locale, emergency wording and Japanese radio/register choices without substituting a Japanese emergency number.

Preserve the separate gas-utility call, the employee's attributed about-20-minute arrival and do-not-touch-line statement, Teresa the crossing guard, school notification and firefighter evacuation decision. Keep possible leak distinct from confirmed leak, and review all technical and school-scene facts before selecting audio or learner answers.

The source teaches direct orders and conditional clauses. Review Japanese command/register adaptation and six authored prompt/target pairs; eight private term phrases exactly match English fragments but none is a full approved speaker-labeled Reader turn.

rows.sourceSpanish: En la ampliación de la calle Jefferson, cerca de una escuela, el operador Raúl Medina llama por el radio al capataz Javier Ortiz.
rows.sourceEnglish: On the Jefferson Street widening job, near a school, operator Raúl Medina calls foreman Javier Ortiz on the radio.

rows.sourceSpanish: Raúl: El cucharón golpeó algo, siento un olor a gas muy fuerte y escucho un silbido.
rows.sourceEnglish: Raúl: The bucket hit something, I smell a very strong gas smell and I hear a hissing sound.
rows.speaker: Raúl

rows.sourceSpanish: Javier: ¡Paren todo y aléjense de la zanja ahora!
rows.sourceEnglish: Javier: Stop everything and get away from the trench now!
rows.speaker: Javier
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 全作業中止！ 全員、今すぐ掘削溝から離れて！

rows.sourceSpanish: Javier: Raúl, apaga la máquina si es seguro y aléjate caminando.
rows.sourceEnglish: Javier: Raúl, shut off the machine if it's safe and walk away.
rows.speaker: Javier
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: ラウル、安全にできるならエンジンを切って、歩いて離れて。

rows.sourceSpanish: Javier: Que nadie prenda cigarros ni arranque motores.
rows.sourceEnglish: Javier: Nobody light cigarettes or start engines.
rows.speaker: Javier
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 誰もタバコに火をつけないで。エンジンもかけないで。

rows.sourceSpanish: Javier explica que una sola chispa puede encender el gas, así que todas las fuentes de ignición se quedan apagadas.
rows.sourceEnglish: Javier explains that a single spark can ignite the gas, so all ignition sources stay off.

rows.sourceSpanish: Javier revisa la dirección del viento y manda a la cuadrilla al punto de reunión en la esquina norte, lejos del gas.
rows.sourceEnglish: Javier checks the wind direction and sends the crew to the assembly point on the north corner, away from the gas.

rows.sourceSpanish: Javier: Si el viento cambia, moveremos el punto de reunión.
rows.sourceEnglish: Javier: If the wind changes, we'll move the assembly point.
rows.speaker: Javier

rows.sourceSpanish: Luego Javier llama al 911 y dice: Llamo para reportar un olor a gas en una obra.
rows.sourceEnglish: Then Javier calls 911 and says: I'm calling to report a gas smell at a construction site.
rows.speaker: Then Javier calls 911 and says
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: 工事現場でガスのにおいがしています。通報します。

rows.sourceSpanish: Javier: Nuestra excavadora golpeó algo y huele a gas; hay una escuela cerca.
rows.sourceEnglish: Javier: Our excavator hit something and it smells like gas; there's a school nearby.
rows.speaker: Javier
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: バックホーが何かに当たってしまい、ガスのにおいがします。近くに学校があります。

rows.sourceSpanish: La operadora dice que los bomberos van en camino, y Javier responde: Si me llaman, les daré la ubicación exacta.
rows.sourceEnglish: The dispatcher says the firefighters are on their way, and Javier answers: If they call me, I'll give them the exact location.
rows.speaker: The dispatcher says the firefighters are on their way, and Javier answers

rows.sourceSpanish: Después Javier llama a la compañía de gas para reportar una posible fuga en la línea de gas.
rows.sourceEnglish: Next Javier calls the gas company to report a possible leak in the gas line.

rows.sourceSpanish: Javier: ¿En cuánto tiempo llegará su equipo de emergencia?
rows.sourceEnglish: Javier: How soon will your emergency crew get here?
rows.speaker: Javier
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: そちらの緊急対応チームは、あと何分ぐらいで到着しますか。

rows.sourceSpanish: La empleada de la compañía dice que su equipo llegará en unos 20 minutos y que nadie debe tocar la línea.
rows.sourceEnglish: The gas company employee says her crew will arrive in about 20 minutes and that nobody should touch the line.

rows.sourceSpanish: Mientras tanto, Teresa Aguilar, la guardia de cruce, se acerca curiosa a la cinta de precaución que la cuadrilla acaba de poner.
rows.sourceEnglish: Meanwhile, Teresa Aguilar, the crossing guard, curiously walks up to the caution tape the crew has just put up.

rows.sourceSpanish: Javier: Señora, por favor no se acerque; hay una posible fuga de gas.
rows.sourceEnglish: Javier: Ma'am, please don't come closer; there may be a gas leak.
rows.speaker: Javier
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: すみません、そこの方、それ以上近づかないでください。ガス漏れのおそれがあります。

rows.sourceSpanish: Javier le pide a Teresa que regrese a la escuela y avise, porque los bomberos decidirán si hace falta la evacuación.
rows.sourceEnglish: Javier asks Teresa to go back to the school and let them know, because the firefighters will decide whether an evacuation is needed.

rows.sourceSpanish: Javier: Si alguien cruza la cinta, yo lo pararé.
rows.sourceEnglish: Javier: If anyone crosses the tape, I'll stop them.
rows.speaker: Javier
rows.conditionalJapanesePhrase: もし誰かがテープを越えたら、私が止めます。
